newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki adds over one pct, smashes more records.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki adds over one pct, smashes more records.

text.p: Shares finished a strong session with a late dash to yet higher record levels on Thursday, but brokers said the coming U.S. Independence Day break may invite profit-taking on Friday despite otherwise bullish sentiment.

Pushed by buoyant U.S. markets, both the FOX futures index and the HEX all-share index added 1.55 percent to new all-time highs: for the FOX, 1,134.32 points, the HEX 3,295.08 points. The indices have risen over 30 percent so far this year.
Blue-chips led the broad rally, with Nokia adding 11.50 markka to match an all-time high 395.00 as a spurt of foreign buying kicked in ahead of the New York open, brokers said.
